'''Viado Denan''' was a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was part of an Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as an artifice expert.
